mala.headline: A quieter way to keep count.
mala.lede: Mala is a tactile, distraction-free companion for repetition practice—designed to disappear into the rhythm instead of competing with it.
mala.audience: For anyone who wants a simple digital mala without feeds, accounts, or performative streaks.

benefits.title: Count by feel
benefits.body: A large practice surface and restrained feedback keep attention on the repetition.

benefits.title: Resume naturally
benefits.body: An interrupted round can continue without turning practice into a productivity task.

benefits.title: Make it yours
benefits.body: Private labels, multiple mala styles, and local history support a personal ritual.

steps: Choose a round and an optional private label.
Tap through each repetition at your own pace.
Complete the round and keep the history on your device.
mala.privacy: No account, advertising, analytics, tracking, or developer-operated service. Practice information stays in the app's local storage.
mala.limitation: Mala supports practice; it does not provide religious instruction, health guidance, or social features.

themes.name: Thread of 108
themes.principle: One unbroken strand carries the page.

themes.name: Eyes Closed
themes.principle: The eyes-free promise becomes the interface.

themes.name: Bead Ledger
themes.principle: A crafted specimen sheet for the mala collection.

anjali.headline: One sacred pause for the moment you are in.
anjali.lede: Anjali offers a short, offline prayer experience shaped around dawn, transition, gratitude, difficulty, and rest—without presenting itself as a guide or authority.
anjali.audience: For people who want a brief, private moment of Hindu prayer without opening a feed or starting a long session.

benefits.title: Brief by design
benefits.body: Open Anjali, meet one focused prayer, and return to your day.

benefits.title: Available offline
benefits.body: Bundled content works without an account or developer-operated service.

benefits.title: Return gently
benefits.body: Optional local reminders and favorites help make room for the moments that matter.

steps: Choose the moment you are in.
Read or chant one short prayer at your own pace.
Save what matters or close the app when the pause is complete.
anjali.privacy: No account, backend, analytics, advertising, tracking, third-party SDKs, or purchases. Preferences and activity remain on-device.
anjali.limitation: Current Chant practice is self-led and silent. Anjali does not claim religious authority and is not a puja guide.

themes.name: Six Lights
themes.principle: Five moments are organized by the changing light.

themes.name: Under a Minute
themes.principle: A complete, intentionally finite sixty-second read.

themes.name: Threshold
themes.principle: Quiet architectural thresholds hold each idea.

svara.headline: A daily practice rooted in Hindu culture.
svara.lede: Svara brings practices, festivals, stories, and reflection into one local-first path that can grow without asking you to perform your spirituality.
svara.audience: For people seeking a culturally rooted daily companion that balances guidance, discovery, and private progress.

benefits.title: Follow a path
benefits.body: Lessons and practices create a clear next step without flattening the tradition into a checklist.

benefits.title: Meet the calendar
benefits.body: Festival and story experiences connect practice with cultural time and context.

benefits.title: Keep progress local
benefits.body: Practice history, points, achievements, and reflections stay on the device.

steps: Choose a practice, lesson, festival, or story.
Move through the experience with bundled audio where it exists.
Return through optional local reminders and continue your path.
svara.privacy: No account, developer analytics, advertising, or cross-app tracking. Practice data and reflections are not sent to a developer-operated server.
svara.limitation: Audio is available only where bundled. Progress mechanics support orientation and are not a measure of spiritual worth.

themes.name: The Ascent
themes.principle: A rising practice path becomes the page spine.

themes.name: Almanac
themes.principle: A seasonal cultural broadsheet leads with the calendar.

themes.name: Constellation of Practice
themes.principle: Practices, festivals, and stories form an explorable field.

roam.headline: See the places you have actually explored.
roam.lede: Roam colors in a private map as you travel, turning local visit history into a satisfying picture of where you have been.
roam.audience: For curious travelers who want a personal coverage map without handing their saved history to a travel social network.

benefits.title: Watch coverage grow
benefits.body: Visited ZIP Code Areas and countries accumulate into a map that feels tangible.

benefits.title: Choose permission deliberately
benefits.body: A staged location flow explains foreground and background access before you opt in.

benefits.title: Share the summary
benefits.body: Create aggregate coverage cards or export your data when you choose.

steps: Choose how much location access to grant.
Travel while Roam matches samples against bundled geographic boundaries.
Review, export, or share aggregate coverage on your terms.
roam.privacy: No Roam account, developer cloud, advertising, or third-party analytics. Apple services process what MapKit, Core Location, and StoreKit require.
roam.limitation: ZIP Code Areas are Census approximations, not postal delivery boundaries. Automatic tracking requires location permission.

themes.name: Fill the Grid
themes.principle: A fictional cell field colors in as the page unfolds.

themes.name: Field Atlas
themes.principle: A plate-bound atlas makes the legend the navigation.

themes.name: Redacted
themes.principle: Reveal and withhold controls make privacy visible.

hindsight.headline: Compare what you expected with what happened.
hindsight.lede: Hindsight is an on-device decision journal for recording predictions before the outcome arrives, then returning with curiosity instead of self-punishment.
hindsight.audience: For people who want to notice how they make decisions without turning uncertainty into a public scorecard.

benefits.title: Record the belief
benefits.body: Capture an expectation and confidence before knowing the result.

benefits.title: Seal the entry
benefits.body: Keep the original thinking intact until it is time to revisit it.

benefits.title: Reflect on evidence
benefits.body: Compare belief and outcome, then add context that a simple result cannot hold.

steps: Write what you expect and how confident you feel.
Seal the prediction until its review date.
Record the outcome and reflect on what changed.
hindsight.privacy: Hindsight runs on-device with no networking code, backend, account, analytics, advertising, or tracking.
hindsight.limitation: Outcome labels organize reflection; they do not judge the quality of a person or guarantee better future decisions.

themes.name: Sealed Envelope
themes.principle: Each belief remains sealed until the outcome arrives.

themes.name: The Ledger Spread
themes.principle: Belief and outcome occupy two calm, equal columns.

themes.name: Fork in the Timeline
themes.principle: Chosen and unchosen branches remain visible together.
